No amounts have been fabricated or estimated.

RECOMMENDATION: To produce a complete statement, provide: (1) QuickBooks P&L with populated income and expense figures, (2) comparative Balance Sheet with prior-year ending balances, (3) General Ledger detail for the full 2025 period, and (4) WildApricot data filtered to the 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31 period.

partI_summary.missionStatement: The Kansas City Woodworkers Guild promotes the art and craft of woodworking through education, community engagement, and shared access to tools and facilities. The Guild provides members with instruction, workshops, and a collaborative environment to develop woodworking skills at all levels.

partIII_programServiceAccomplishments.missionStatement: The Kansas City Woodworkers Guild promotes the art and craft of woodworking through education, community engagement, and shared access to tools and facilities. The Guild provides members with instruction, workshops, and a collaborative environment to develop woodworking skills at all levels.

programServices.description: Membership programs and woodworking education: The Guild provided members with access to woodworking instruction, monthly meetings, special interest group (SIG) sessions covering topics such as hand tools, CNC, laser engraving, finishing, and carving, as well as Rough to Ready workshops and basic and intermediate woodworking classes. Membership dues collected during the tax year supported these educational and community activities.

Community outreach and public events: The Guild participated in community engagement activities including the National Craft Open Studios Weekend, providing the public with exposure to woodworking arts and crafts. No revenue was recorded for this program during the tax year.

Facility and tool access for members: The Guild maintained shared workshop facilities and equipment enabling members to pursue woodworking projects. No separate revenue or expense was recorded for this program during the tax year in the available financial data.

line4d_otherProgramServices.description: No other program services reported for the tax year.

scheduleO.narrative: The Kansas City Woodworkers Guild Inc. promotes the art and craft of woodworking through education, community engagement, and shared access to tools and facilities. The Guild provides members with instruction, workshops, monthly meetings, special interest group sessions (covering hand tools, CNC, laser engraving, finishing, and carving), Rough to Ready workshops, and basic and intermediate woodworking classes. The Guild also engages the broader community through public events such as the National Craft Open Studios Weekend.

The organization does not currently have a formal documented process for governing body review of the Form 990 prior to filing. The Treasurer reviews the return and makes it available to officers upon request. The organization intends to implement a formal review process in future years.

The organization makes its governing documents and financial statements available to the public upon written request directed to the Treasurer at 1717 Washington St, Kansas City, MO 64108-1121. The organization does not currently post these documents on a publicly accessible website.
